text:
The evidence doesn't cover 2026, so it can't say whether tree cover changed this year.

The assessment covers 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Within that window, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the 374.8 ha property, and valid satellite observations covered the whole asset. The latest observed year in the data is 2025.

For context, Hansen data show 48.4 ha of tree cover in 2000, and JRC data show 43.3 ha of forest in 2020 (11.55% of the property).

Limits:
- "Not detected" doesn't mean nothing changed. Losses under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed.
- Gains or other changes weren't assessed, only loss.
- No regulatory or compliance conclusion (e.g., deforestation-free) can be drawn.

To answer about 2026, you'd need newer data once a 2026 series is released.
